Workflow.Name: Bill invoice in PayPal
Workflow.Description: Creates and sends a PayPal invoice for one Dynamics 365 invoice (by its invoice ID from Preview invoice), then saves the PayPal invoice ID, status, payment link and sent date on the Dynamics 365 invoice. Returns the PayPal invoice ID and payment link. Only use after the user explicitly confirmed. Returns ALREADY_SENT if the invoice was already billed.
